name: indian-day-trader-skill
description: The Day Trader skill pack for Claude, adapted for the Indian stock market (NSE)

owner.name: Jake Schincariol (original US pack); India adaptation

plugins.name: indian-day-trader-skill
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading Indian stocks on NSE: a Nifty 500 chart scanner, an NSE news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner on NSE ticks, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions with Indian charges, a risk manager, a rupee budget manager, an order ticket builder (ticket-only by default, Zerodha Kite format, never without your yes), price alerts on the NSE calendar, an earnings analyst for Indian results and an insider / bulk-deal tracker.
